description: Central logging configuration contract for the Stats application. Modules may implement logging locally, but behavior must follow this registry.

LOG_INCLUDE_CORRELATION_ID.purpose: Whether logs should include request/correlation identifiers when available.

LOG_REDACT_SENSITIVE_VALUES.purpose: Whether known sensitive values must be redacted before logging.

redaction.evidenceRule: Evidence may include redacted summaries and status metadata, not raw sensitive payloads.

containerRule: All containerized services write logs to stdout/stderr so Docker, CI, and later Azure logging can collect them without file scraping.
moduleRule: Module-local logging_config.py or equivalent setup is allowed, but it must consume the central logging variables and honor the redaction and stdout rules.
